name: 3D Cartoon Animation: colours and fonts
source: The colours and fonts of the approved film "How gravity was found". The engine's own values are BRAND and HIGHLIGHT in recipe/engine/core.mjs; recipe/tools/style-sheet.mjs checks that this file matches them.

colours.name: Rouge Noir
colours.use: the hero's clothes, roofs, doors, the title-hook box, counter labels

colours.name: Blue Coral
colours.use: a second character's clothes (lifted so it doesn't read as black), leaves, water-like sets

colours.name: Cognac
colours.use: wood: trees, fences, frames, desks, shoes

colours.name: White Sand
colours.use: walls, paper, the caption and title text

colours.name: Brand Red
colours.use: the italic caption words: Rouge Noir lifted so it reads on any background (same hue)

fonts.role: the italic words in captions and the title
fonts.name: Instrument Serif Italic

fonts.role: labels on props: counters, calendars, signs
fonts.name: Titan One
